subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add `ready_to_merge` as a durable review-gate status, or should review enforcement reuse the existing `review` lifecycle?
rationale: The PR adds a new persisted status and fail-closed completion behavior that can change existing Workboard upgrade/runtime behavior, so code repair alone cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Repair With Explicit Durable Status
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers want `ready_to_merge`, with contracts, UI consumers, tests, upgrade expectations, and real proof fixed before merge.

options.title: Reuse Existing Review Status
options.body: Ask for a narrower redesign that enforces review proof while keeping the existing stored status model.

options.title: Pause The Direction
options.body: Close or pause the PR if Workboard review gates are not ready to become a core bundled plugin lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Repair With Explicit Durable Status
recommendation.body: Proceed only if maintainers want `ready_to_merge`, with contracts, UI consumers, tests, upgrade expectations, and real proof fixed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal for the Workboard lifecycle, manifest, docs, and persisted status surfaces touched by this PR.
